body: My map got denied and I was wondering if someone could help me make it better also the map isnt one hit kill please send me a way to contact me below ! To hopefully make it better and not bad like tanpopo said the first one was terrible ! Or change it to DTM instead of TDM!

title: Help improving a map !

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Now I'm not a pro map maker, but if I was you, I would just start from scratch again. To get some ideas/inspiration, look at the maps in the current rotation! Looking at these maps could give you an idea aesthetically, and also gameplay-wise. While getting ideas, don't actually copy the overall layout, come up with something similar, but different. 

Good luck!
